record.question: The rank-size rule does not work when one considers the distribution of
options: All of the citizens in a given country
All of the cities in a given country
All of the counties, provinces, or parishes within a given state
All of the polities within a given region
record.explanation: Printed page 6 confirms "citizens", rather than cities. The rank-size rule relates the populations of settlements or territorial units to their ranks (approximately P_r = P_1/r); individual citizens do not constitute differently sized population units. See Gabaix, Zipf's Law for Cities (1999): https://doi.org/10.1162/003355399556133.
